header:
# Town of Waterbury municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 25; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Waterbury, Selectboard page (waterburyvt.com): lists the current five-member board -- Martha Staskus (Chair), Don Schneider (Vice Chair), Sandy Sabin (Secretary), Roger Clapp, and Evan Karl Hoffman. The June 2026 Secretary of State directory's three rows were partial

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 159 (Town of Waterbury): the charter contains only a local-option tax (sec. 1) and the municipal-manager provision (sec. 2, Act M-20, effective March 29, 2024); it does not displace the elected town officers of 17 V.S.A. sec. 2646
Town of Waterbury, Clerk page (waterburyvt.com): names Wes Pollock as Town Clerk. The Secretary of State's Guide lists Beth Jones as 'temporary' clerk (stale -- Jones now sits as a lister)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Wes Pollock as Waterbury's Town Clerk

Town of Waterbury, Clerk page: names William Shepeluk as Town Treasurer, without qualification. The Secretary of State's Guide styles him 'temporary' treasurer and spells the name 'Shepeluka'; the transition is complete on the town's own site and its spelling governs (disclosed on #163). The June 2026 treasurer spreadsheet carries no Waterbury row

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator; no current official source names a Waterbury moderator (the town votes its articles by Australian ballot), so the post is created without a membership); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: Town of Waterbury, Listers page (waterburyvt.com): the three listers -- Bob Butler, Alec Tuscany, and Beth Jones -- sign the town's July 2026 grievance notice. Butler is also a Justice of the Peace; one person record carries both memberships
Town of Waterbury, Cemetery Commission page (waterburyvt.com): lists Jill Chase, Robert Dostis, Jan Gendreau, and John Woodruff IV (Chair); the fifth seat is shown VACANT on the town's page

Town of Waterbury, Library Commission page (waterburyvt.com): lists Michelle Baker, Anna Black (Chair), Erin Mooney, and Kit Walker; the fifth seat is shown VACANT on the town's page. Mooney is also a Justice of the Peace; one person record carries both memberships

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Waterbury justices of the peace: Jim Adams, John Bauer, Bob Butler, Linda Gravell, Steve Karcher, Amanda McKay, Chris McKay, Mary Miller, Erin Mooney, Bob Stanton, Liz Schlegel Stevens, and Katrina VanTyne

jp_election.name: Town of Waterbury Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the twelve winners of Waterbury's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for twelve): Jim Adams, John Bauer, Bob Butler, Linda Gravell, Steve Karcher, Amanda McKay, Chris McKay, Mary Miller, Erin Mooney, Bob Stanton, Liz Schlegel Stevens, and Katrina VanTyne. All twelve remain in office
